sources: function step(ctx) { const bs=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:100}); const inns=bs.filter(b=>b.shortType===1 && !b.virtual); return {output:{inns:inns.map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,workers:b.workers,construction:b.construction}))}}; }

function step(ctx) { const b=ctx.game.building({id:1,generation:1}); if(!b || b.team!==ctx.myTeam || b.shortType!==1) return {output:{queued:false,reason:'inn no longer matches observed reference'}}; return {output:{queued:true},orders:[{type:'workers',building:{id:b.id,generation:b.generation},workers:5}]}; }

function step(ctx) { const b=ctx.game.building({id:1,generation:1}); return {output:b && b.team===ctx.myTeam ? {workers:b.workers,construction:b.construction,verified:b.workers===5} : {verified:false,reason:'inn unavailable'}}; }

function step(ctx) { const bs=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); const inns=bs.filter(b=>b.shortType===1&&!b.virtual); return {output:{inns:inns.map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,priority:b.priority,construction:b.construction}))},orders:inns.filter(b=>b.priority!==1).slice(0,32).map(b=>({type:'priority',building:{id:b.id,generation:b.generation},priority:1}))}; }

function step(ctx) { const bs=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); const inns=bs.filter(b=>b.shortType===1&&!b.virtual); return {output:{inns:inns.map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,priority:b.priority}))}}; }

function step(ctx){ const types=ctx.game.buildingTypes().filter(t=>t.shortType===7&&t.level===0); const tile=ctx.game.map.tile(18,18); const buildings=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); return {output:{width:ctx.game.map.width,height:ctx.game.map.height,tile,types,nearby:buildings.filter(b=>b.x===18&&b.y===18)}}; }
function step(ctx){ return {output:{requested:true},orders:[{type:'create',buildingType:38,x:18,y:18,workers:2,futureWorkers:1}]}; }

function step(ctx){ const bs=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); return {output:{tick:ctx.tick,sites:bs.filter(b=>b.shortType===7&&b.x===18&&b.y===18).map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,type:b.type,construction:b.construction,workers:b.workers,futureWorkers:b.futureWorkers,x:b.x,y:b.y}))}}; }

function step(ctx) { const types=ctx.game.buildingTypes().filter(t=>t.virtual && t.shortType===8); const buildings=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:100}); return {output:{width:ctx.game.map.width,height:ctx.game.map.height,types:types.map(t=>({id:t.id,name:t.name,level:t.level,site:t.site,virtual:t.virtual})),flags:buildings.filter(b=>b.virtual).map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,type:b.type,x:b.x,y:b.y,range:b.range,workers:b.workers}))}}; }
function step(ctx) { return {output:{requested:{x:15,y:2,range:6,workers:1}},orders:[{type:'create',buildingType:44,x:15,y:2,range:6,workers:1,futureWorkers:1}]}; }

function step(ctx) { const flags=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}).filter(b=>b.virtual&&b.shortType===8&&b.x===15&&b.y===2); return {output:{tick:ctx.tick,matches:flags.map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,x:b.x,y:b.y,range:b.range,workers:b.workers,construction:b.construction,type:b.type}))}}; }

function step(ctx) { const types=ctx.game.buildingTypes(); const flags=types.filter(t=>t.virtual && t.name==='warflag'); const bs=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); return {output:{flags:flags.map(t=>({id:t.id,name:t.name,level:t.level,site:t.site})),existing:bs.filter(b=>b.virtual&&b.shortType===9).map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,x:b.x,y:b.y,range:b.range,minimumLevel:b.minimumLevel}))}}; }
function step(ctx) { return {orders:[{type:'create',buildingType:45,x:16,y:16,workers:3,futureWorkers:3,range:5}]}; }

function step(ctx) { const bs=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); return {output:bs.filter(b=>b.virtual&&b.shortType===9&&b.x===16&&b.y===16).map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,x:b.x,y:b.y,range:b.range,workers:b.workers,futureWorkers:b.futureWorkers,minimumLevel:b.minimumLevel}))}; }

function step(ctx) { const types=ctx.game.buildingTypes().filter(t=>t.shortType===9 && t.virtual); const buildings=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}).filter(b=>b.virtual && b.shortType===9); return {output:{types,flags:buildings.map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,type:b.type,x:b.x,y:b.y,range:b.range,minimumLevel:b.minimumLevel}))}}; }
function step(ctx) { return {orders:[{type:'create',buildingType:45,x:8,y:20,workers:1,futureWorkers:1,range:3}]}; }

function step(ctx) { const flags=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}).filter(b=>b.virtual && b.shortType===9 && b.x===8 && b.y===20); return {output:flags.map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,range:b.range,workers:b.workers,minimumLevel:b.minimumLevel}))}; }

function step(ctx) { const buildings=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); return {output:{inns:buildings.filter(b=>b.shortType===1).map(b=>({id:b.id,generation:b.generation,workers:b.workers,construction:b.construction,virtual:b.virtual}))}}; }

function step(ctx) { const inns=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}).filter(b=>b.shortType===1 && !b.virtual); const orders=inns.filter(b=>b.workers!==4).map(b=>({type:'workers',building:{id:b.id,generation:b.generation},workers:4})).slice(0,32); return {output:{inns:inns.length,ordersQueued:orders.length},orders}; }

function step(ctx) { const inns=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}).filter(b=>b.shortType===1 && !b.virtual); return {output:inns.map(b=>({workers:b.workers,construction:b.construction}))}; }
